title: Tofu spinach with tahini
summary: Tofu spinach with tahini is a middle eastern dinner built around firm tofu and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat firm tofu dry and season it. Prep baby spinach and tahini for Tofu spinach with tahini so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook firm tofu on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook baby spinach and tahini in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Tofu spinach with tahini before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice firm tofu and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
